turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I didn't come here to write poetry. The zero comes off, Owen gets an apology, and you tell me who decided it.
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
I don't communicate in emoji, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I don't shout, and I don't need to. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
No. I'm not putting my son's grade into verse. Nobody called me before that zero went in, so what exactly do you have?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
November 3. That's the date on the gradebook, and I'm writing it down. Your own procedure says a parent is called before any mark goes in, so why didn't I get one?
